# ClawBio Scholar

ClawBio Scholar is a planned companion project to ClawBio focused on biomedical and computational-biology PhD workflows.

## Goal

Turn doctoral research work into reproducible, auditable, publication-ready, citable outputs.

## Core outcomes

- verified literature ingestion
- evidence graph + claims model
- study-design and reporting-guideline awareness
- workflow scaffolding and provenance
- Quarto-based manuscript and thesis generation
- DOI-ready software release packaging

## Important files

- `AGENTS.md` — working contract for coding agents
- `plans/master-plan.md` — milestone-by-milestone source of truth
- `plans/implement.md` — execution rules for Codex
- `plans/documentation.md` — running status / decisions log
- `docs/01-architecture.md` — research object model and system design
- `docs/03-evaluation.md` — benchmark strategy and release gates

## Project layout

- `apps/`
- `packages/`
- `scholar-skills/`
- `templates/`
- `examples/`
- `benchmarks/`
- `paper/`
- `.agents/skills/`

## Current status

Planning scaffold only. Product code is not implemented yet.
